title: 学术三态判断：车站标牌试用
instruction: 阅读完整材料，判断每条陈述：TRUE表示材料支持，FALSE表示材料提供矛盾信息，NOT GIVEN表示材料既未支持也未反驳。只依据本文，不用外部知识补充。
source_notice: 题型参照既存官方学术阅读样题包12—14页：一份自成输入的节选支撑三陈述，TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN，不能用外部知识补信息。官方完整题面/键已核图，原传记史实未另做事实核证，原文本出版许可不转授本项目。新增稿件全为虚构原创案例，不复制原材料；此为高级档的学术任务形式参照，不新增雅思备考档，不证明产品难度、CEFR/分数等值、教师/学生标定、商用或生产通过。其他官方学术阅读具体形式仍待逐项复核。
paragraphs: A fictional transport laboratory tested a redesigned station sign by asking visitors to follow a marked route through an empty training hall. Participants were unfamiliar with the hall, and each used only one version of the sign system. The route contained the same number of junctions for both groups. An observer noted wrong turns, requests for help and the point at which a participant reached the final doorway. Completion time was measured from the first junction, rather than from entry into the building, so the recorded times did not include the introductory briefing.

The study team reported that fewer visitors using the new signs asked for assistance. However, the authors separated this finding from the question of whether the design worked equally well for all readers. The pilot had recruited adults who could read the language used on the signs. No children were included, and the sample did not allow the team to compare readers with different levels of fluency. The report described the reduction in requests as evidence worth following up, while explicitly limiting the population to which that observation could reasonably be applied.

Before a further trial, the team recommended moving one arrow away from a doorway because its position could suggest that the doorway itself was the destination. They did not recommend changing the sign’s background colour. A record of the pilot and the proposed revision was sent to the station operator. The next trial would use the corrected arrow position while leaving the route unchanged. The authors’ immediate concern was to make the next trial distinguish a positioning problem from a problem with the wording.

questions.stem: The recorded completion times left out the introductory briefing.
options: 材料给出与陈述矛盾的信息
材料既未支持也未反驳该陈述
questions.evidence_quote: the recorded times did not include the introductory briefing.
questions.rationale: TRUE：计时从首个岔口开始，明确不含briefing，陈述一致；FALSE：没有计入briefing的反向信息；NOT GIVEN：计时边界明确而非未提

questions.stem: Children took part in the pilot study.
options: 材料给出与陈述矛盾的信息
材料既未支持也未反驳该陈述
questions.rationale: TRUE：all adults且No children否定参与儿童；FALSE：明示No children，与陈述有矛盾；NOT GIVEN：儿童是否参加明文说明，不能判缺信息

questions.stem: Most visitors preferred the appearance of the redesigned signs.
options: 材料给出与陈述矛盾的信息
材料既未支持也未反驳该陈述
questions.rationale: TRUE：少请求帮助衡量导航行为，不是审美喜好，不能推出多数偏爱外观；FALSE：没有多数不喜欢外观或喜好比较数据，故不是反驳；NOT GIVEN：全文没有个人外观感受记录；表现数据也不能替代外观偏好
